location: Deir Jarir; Sinjil; Tuba; Humsa al-Bqai'a; Qarawat Bani Hassan
summary: OCHA aggregates five settler assaults/pepper-spray incidents injuring 14 Palestinians, including a child and elderly woman, across five locations/dates.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; PCHR weekly update 16-22 Mar 2023; prior canonical ILPV-2023-0317
resolution_notes: Targeted decomposition recheck preserves the aggregate rather than guessing date/location allocation. PCHR independently documents a Khirbet al-Tuba assault on 16 March 2023, already canonical as ILPV-2023-0317, but OCHA's five-event aggregate explicitly lists 15, 18, 21, 25 and 26 March; the Mar. 16 Tuba event therefore cannot responsibly be used to resolve the OCHA Tuba component. Renewed English/Arabic searches for exact Sinjil/Tuba assaults on the aggregate dates did not recover a defensible event-level match. Deir Jarir, Humsa and Qarawat Bani Hassan remain separately resolved; MAR23-014 remains Unresolved.
media_status: No new exact incident media recovered; no generic or merely related imagery used.
